name: The Westin Beach Resort & Spa at Frenchman’s Reef
insider_take: Perched dramatically on a clifftop peninsula, this iconic resort offers unparalleled panoramic views of the Caribbean Sea and Charlotte Amalie harbor from every angle.
whats_special: The resort sits on the historic Frenchman's Reef, where French pirates once anchored their ships in the 1600s. As the largest full-service resort in the U.S. Virgin Islands, it features the island's only overwater experience with floating cabanas and boasts one of the Caribbean's most stunning infinity pools that appears to blend seamlessly with the azure horizon.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the Point Pleasant Restaurant for Instagram-worthy shots of cruise ships departing Charlotte Amalie harbor while enjoying locally-caught mahi-mahi with a backdrop of Carnival and Royal Caribbean vessels.
dont_miss: The world-famous Coral World Ocean Park is just 15 minutes away, featuring underwater observation towers and sea turtle encounters. Plus, take advantage of duty-free shopping in Charlotte Amalie - the resort offers complimentary shuttle service to downtown's tax-free jewelry and luxury goods districts.
pros: Spectacular panoramic ocean views from clifftop location
Multiple pristine beaches and water sports activities
Full-service spa with signature Westin wellness programs
Premium Caribbean resort dining and entertainment options
cons: Island location requires flight connections for most travelers
Premium pricing reflects luxury Caribbean resort positioning
